chunks: Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام was asked about a man whose khuff is torn, so he inserts his hand and wipes the top of his feet: would that suffice him?

key_terms.ظَهْرَ قَدَمَيْهِ: the top of his two feet

ai.seo_question: Is wiping the top of the feet through a torn khuff sufficient in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning wudu (ablution) when a person's khuff is torn. It indicates that if he can insert his hand and wipe the top of his feet, that act is sufficient.
